relationships.subject: NSAIDs
relationships.evidence_quote: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) inhibit the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX), which forms prostaglandins involved in pain and inflammation.

relationships.subject: COX-2 inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: An increased risk of suffering myocardial infarction and death with COX-2 inhibitor treatment is well established from clinical trials and observational research.

key_findings: COX-2 inhibitors increase myocardial infarction risk; diclofenac is as COX-2 selective as celecoxib
Trials exaggerated GI benefits by using maximal NSAID doses
